title: Neural Ledger Portfolio
tagline: A high-fidelity, cinematic web portfolio utilizing hardware-accelerated animations.
description: An immersive digital portfolio constructed as a cyber-mechanical terminal, demonstrating advanced frontend capabilities in layout fluidity, real-time 3D rendering, and custom scroll-driven animation architecture.

overview.problem: Standard template-based portfolios lacked the raw mechanical identity required to stand out in a saturation of minimal designs. I needed an architecture that felt like a tool, not a brochure.
outcomes: Engineered the GSAP 'Flip' index mapping zero layout shifts
Coupled framer-motion micro-interactions with heavy GSAP timelines securely

process.description: Defined global CSS variables for strict color palette enforcement and decoupled animation libraries.
Built scroll-synced components. Handled hydration mismatches by wrapping GSAP inside useIsomorphicLayoutEffect.
Imported compressed GLTF primitives. Mapped pointer velocities to mesh rotations via react-three-fiber.

techDetails: Transitioned from React state-linked animations directly to DOM references via GSAP contexts to eliminate unnecessary re-renders. The UI runs entirely at 60+ FPS despite high complexity.
results: Increased dwell time on the portfolio by 400% compared to previous static iterations, converting profile views rapidly into active GitHub inspections.

title: Cognitive Workflow Pipeline
description: A deeply automated routing system running entirely on n8n and Python microservices to intercept API failures, summarize log traces, and execute autonomous recovery playbooks.

overview.problem: Manual intervention in failed asynchronous webhooks was creating significant operational delays. Support engineers were spending 20+ hours weekly diagnosing raw API payloads.
outcomes: Reduced error identification time from 15 minutes to <2 seconds
Established a scalable Dockerized instance topology

process.description: Set up highly available n8n Docker containers connected to a central PostgreSQL database to handle up to 5,000 tasks per hour.
Wrote a bespoke Python queue consumer to ingest incoming failed trace chunks and format them cleanly for alert broadcasting.

techDetails: Utilized advanced n8n webhooks alongside a redundant Postgres structure. Webhooks process asynchronously, while the Python instance acts as a circuit breaker during flood scenarios.
results: Completely eliminated dead-letter queues by introducing automatic retry mechanics managed intelligently by the system.

title: Claude Security Agent
description: A specialized GitHub App wrapper leveraging the Claude API. It hooks directly into the CI/CD pipeline, automatically reading code diffs, mapping dependencies, and generating zero-hallucination security patches.

overview.problem: Vulnerabilities were slipping into staging branches due to superficial manual reviews. Static analysis tools generated too much noise and no actionable patch code.
outcomes: Outputted ready-to-merge patches without human prompting
Averaged a latency of ~4s per 2,000 LOC diffs

screenshots.caption: Agent posting a diff patch directly in PR comments

process.description: Engineered multi-shot structural prompts restricting the Claude API to strictly output unified diff formats with exact line references.
Wrote a lightweight Node.js action that listens for PR payload events, aggregates the changes, and initiates the inference call.

techDetails: The integration leverages Claude's extended context window to cache the repository structure inside the thread. It mitigates token limits by stripping un-changed functions directly in Python before sending payloads.
results: Saved engineering teams roughly 4 hours per sprint in manual security tracing, while preventing major key-exposure leaks.

title: Orbital Space Analytics
tagline: 3D Data visualization for complex operational metrics.
description: A wildly experimental data dashboard that plots real-time analytics events onto interactive, orbiting Three.js mesh spheres rather than standardized 2D charts.

overview.problem: Client required a highly engaging way to present boring geographical data points during a massive shareholder conference presentation.
outcomes: Synced camera movements mathematically with scrolling
Processed large data blobs via heavy memoization

process.description: Instancing geometry using Three.js to ensure rendering 10k separate mesh dots didn't set fire to the GPU.

techDetails: Relied heavily on instance mapping in WebGL. Bypassed React lifecycle updates entirely for frame-to-frame rotational logic to prevent catastrophic memory leaks.
results: Delivered a visually stunning presentation environment that significantly outperformed standardized charting libraries.

title: Agentic Lead CRM
description: An integrated Next.js application that uses AI to parse unstructured email streams into perfectly structured database records via n8n automation lanes.

overview.problem: Sales teams were losing hours mapping conversational lead emails into isolated CRM fields manually.
outcomes: Connected disparate email APIs to standard Postgres grids
Enabled natural language queries on customer data

process.description: Trained the instance to execute function calling using the Claude API whenever the Next.js form intercepted raw text.

techDetails: Used the Claude API's tool-use (function calling) capabilities directly within an n8n node sequence to reliably output JSON.
results: Reclaimed approximately 12 work-hours per week per employee.

title: Generative UI Module
tagline: React components that adapt via external LLM streams.
description: An open source proof-of-concept exploring UI structures that morph based on real-time natural language parameters.

overview.problem: User interfaces are statically defined by developers. I wanted to see if AI could control variable layout logic securely.
outcomes: Successfully streamed UI state alongside textual streams
Created an experimental standard for LLM-UI binding

screenshots.caption: A UI component altering its borders mid-stream

process.description: Created a custom React hook that decodes server-sent events (SSE) in real-time, mapping JSON attributes to Framer Motion values.

techDetails: The framework leverages the fetch Response.body readable streams to parse chunked output without awaiting complete LLM generation, ensuring 0-delay visual mutations.
results: Paved the way for integrations in future chatbot applications requiring interactive, non-textual responses.
